name: quota-left
description: Subscription quota, context left, prompt cache expiry and API cost under the Claude Code prompt, plus /quota

cost.title: Show API cost
cost.description: Shown only when no subscription quota is reported

priceCacheHit.title: Cache-hit input price
priceCacheHit.description: Per million tokens, at the peak rate; any price above 0 replaces the built-in presets

priceCacheMiss.title: Cache-miss input price
priceCacheMiss.description: Per million tokens, at the peak rate; cache writes are billed at it too

priceOutput.title: Output price
priceOutput.description: Per million tokens, at the peak rate; any price above 0 replaces the built-in presets

offPeakRatio.title: Off-peak ratio
offPeakRatio.description: Off-peak price as a share of peak; 1 for a flat price

peakHours.title: Peak hours
peakHours.description: Weekday hours at the peak rate, e.g. 9-12,14-18

peakUtcOffset.title: Peak hours UTC offset
peakUtcOffset.description: Time zone the peak hours are in, in hours from UTC
